commit ce6feaf6e60e3844c96bc18d0a0f7d95e0dae2b9
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Jun 27 11:17:57 2022 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Mon Jun 27 11:17:57 2022 +1200

    Bug 1967173 - Port bug 1966470: Changes to packaging Makefiles. r=3fe335ac352d
    Port of https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D249448.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D249929

diff --git a/mail/installer/Makefile.in b/mail/installer/Makefile.in
index 9e5c96e7816..03f1ed35d3b 100644
--- a/mail/installer/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/installer/Makefile.in
@@ -117,13 +117,6 @@ ifdef MOZ_NOTIFICATION_SERVER
 DEFINES += -DMOZ_NOTIFICATION_SERVER=1
 endif
 
-ifeq (cocoa,$(MOZ_WIDGET_TOOLKIT))
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_DSSTORE=$(topsrcdir)/$(MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY)/dsstore
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_BACKGROUND=$(topsrcdir)/$(MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY)/background.png
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_ICON=$(topsrcdir)/$(MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY)/disk.icns
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_EXTRA=--symlink '/Applications:/ '
-endif
-
 # The packager minifies two different types of files: non-JS (mostly property
 # files for l10n), and JS.  Setting MOZ_PACKAGER_MINIFY only minifies the
 # former.  We don't yet minify JS, due to concerns about debuggability.
diff --git a/mail/locales/Makefile.in b/mail/locales/Makefile.in
index d79366b4c93..88facc2b211 100644
--- a/mail/locales/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/locales/Makefile.in
@@ -17,22 +17,9 @@ SUBMAKEFILES += \
 
 PWD := $(CURDIR)
 
-# These are defaulted to be compatible with the files the wget-en-US target
-# pulls. You may override them if you provide your own files.
 ZIP_IN ?= $(ABS_DIST)/$(PACKAGE)
 
 MOZ_LANGPACK_EID=langpack-$(AB_CD)@thunderbird.mozilla.org
-# For Nightly, we know where to get the builds from to do local repacks
-ifdef NIGHTLY_BUILD
-export EN_US_BINARY_URL ?= https://archive.mozilla.org/pub/thunderbird/nightly/latest-comm-central
-endif
-
-ifneq (,$(filter cocoa,$(MOZ_WIDGET_TOOLKIT)))
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_DSSTORE=$(ABS_DIST)/branding/dsstore
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_BACKGROUND=$(ABS_DIST)/branding/background.png
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_ICON=$(ABS_DIST)/branding/disk.icns
-MOZ_PKG_MAC_EXTRA=--symlink '/Applications:/ '
-endif
 
 NON_OMNIJAR_FILES = defaults/messenger/mailViews.dat
